The '''ARK-II series Landmaster''' was a wheeled, amphibious, all-terrain vehicle that was constructed by [[Jaffryes Universal Automotive]]. Using four sets of [[Wikipedia:tri-star (wheel arrangement)|tri-wheels]], the Landmaster could handle any terrain, even water. The Landmaster had a triple layered [[Duranium/Legends|duranium]] plating, making it a perennial favorite with explorers traversing dangerous terrain.
